description_zh: 调用ListDbfsAttachedEcsInstances查询数据库文件系统已挂载的ECS实例列表
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs list-dbfs-attached-ecs-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --fs-id dbfs-nUy1tb00000000BQ4X8Gpw --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDbfsAttachedEcsInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region. To view the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions, see [DescribeRegions](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)
